threat_actor_profile.name: Wagner Group / Africa Corps
threat_actor_profile.description: Russian state-linked private military company (PMC) operating across Africa since ~2017. Rebranded as 'Africa Corps' in late 2023 after the Prigozhin rebellion and subsequent restructuring under Russian MOD control. Operates in at least 20 African countries providing security, training, mining concessions, and political influence in exchange for resource access (gold, diamonds, timber, uranium). Core operating model: deploy ex-Spetsnaz/MOD personnel as 'advisors' and 'security contractors' parallel to Russian diplomatic and trade missions.
threat_actor_profile.attribution: Russian Federation — GRU-linked, now directly under Ministry of Defence control post-2023 restructuring

external_references.source: Africa Center for Strategic Studies — Russia tracker

information_operations: Pro-Russian narrative amplification via local media
Anti-French / anti-Western messaging in Francophone Africa
Disinformation campaigns targeting UN peacekeeping missions
resource_extraction: Gold mining concessions (Sudan, CAR, Mali, Zimbabwe)
Uranium and rare earth prospecting (Niger, DRC)
political_influence: Regime security guarantees (CAR, Mali, Burkina Faso)

known_operations.role: Junta security, anti-Tuareg operations, JNIM counter-insurgency
Touadéra regime protection, mining security, anti-rebel operations
Haftar LNA support, oil infrastructure protection
Gold mining operations, RSF support (pre-civil war)

source_quality_notes.primary: All Eyes on Wagner (crowd-sourced OSINT, high reliability for operations tracking)
source_quality_notes.secondary: The Sentry (investigative, strong on financial flows)
source_quality_notes.warning: Russia state media coverage is disinformation — cross-reference with open-source trackers
source_quality_notes.tracking_difficulty: Wagner operates through front companies and local subcontractors making real-time attribution difficult
